items.expected: Identify every added, removed or relocated proton and all corresponding charge/electron changes relative to the parent. Compare different proton counts only using an explicitly balanced chemical reference if making thermodynamic population claims. Keep NMR referencing and solvent separate from water optical observables. Spectral agreement and chemical admissibility must be assessed together.

Provide quantitative optical and NMR evidence appropriate to the proposed species and conditions, or show quantitatively why a joint assignment cannot be resolved. Preserve native structures, calculations and mapping to the observed signal.

items.statement: Evidence that distinguishes the claimed explanation
items.expected: Use independently chosen chemically admissible explanations and discriminating evidence to assess the response. No source endpoint or six-seed list is mandatory; conclusions should account for both observables rather than select one favorable fit.

Assess sensitivity to environment, referencing, species/conformer representation and measurement limitations to the extent required for the assignment. Distinguish a failed geometry search from evidence against a physical species.
